en: The Triplet on Having the Path as Object, the Triplet on the Wholesome.
Conditioned by a non-wholesome state that has the Path as its object, a wholesome state that has the Path as its object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are thirty-five [instances] under root; ... pe ... thirty-five under non-disappearance. (There are none that are neither unwholesome nor indeterminate.)
